title: Compare Exact Product Experiences
summary: Use dated first-party evidence to compare model endpoints, assistants, developer agents, frameworks, and managed agent services.
objectives: Compare exact experiences without ranking entire providers.
Use documented, tested, inference, and unknown evidence correctly.
Separate model capability from harness behavior within a provider family.
Apply observation and review dates to volatile claims.

sections.title: Keep evidence kinds separate
paragraphs: Documented means a current first-party source directly describes a contract or behavior. Tested means a controlled run of the exact version and configuration produced retained evidence. activity.title: Build a dated cross-provider comparison
instructions: Select at least eight exact experiences spanning the eight provider families in the evidence matrix.
Include at least four within-family model-versus-harness comparisons.
Record observable behavior, classification, claim evidence kind, source, observation date, review date, boundaries, and unknowns.
Have another learner challenge one conclusion and revise or defend it using evidence.
evidence: A dated eight-family comparison with no provider-wide classification.
A retained challenge and disposition showing how contradictory or missing evidence was handled.
